newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lernout & Hauspie reports record Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Lernout & Hauspie reports record Q1 1997.

text.p: Belgian computer speech products firm Lernout & Hauspie said on Tuesday revenues in the first quarter of 1997 nearly quadrupled to $16.6 million from $4.7 million in the same period last year.
At the same time net income climbed to $2.7 million against a net loss of $0.7 million in the first three months of 1996.

"Our strong financial results for the first quarter demonstrate that we are making progress towards solidifying our leadership position as the only company that can deliver speech technology solutions for various platforms and in numerous different languages," company President Gaston Bastiaens said.

The company said in a statement that revenues for the first quarter included $6.3 million from its core speech technologies, $6.7 million fron its Mendez translation service and $3.5 million from its continuous dictation project.
